address: 737 Buena Vista Avenue West, San Francisco, CA 94117

assessment.note: The most recent roll carrying this parcel is 2018, not 2025 — unusual, and unexplained by the dataset. Values are seven years stale.

notable_residents.name: Jack London
notable_residents.detail: Recorded by the source as a resident. London was born at 601 Third Street and died in 1916.

notable_residents.name: Danny Glover
notable_residents.detail: Recorded by the source as a resident of the same house at a different time. No dates given.

permit_summary.note: No building permits are recorded for 737 Buena Vista Avenue West in the DBI dataset, which reaches back to the mid-1970s. One of only two addresses documented here with an empty permit record.

narrative.lead: A nineteen-room house on the west side of Buena Vista Park. SF Planning's historic survey records it under a name — the Floyd Spreckels Mansion — which most parcels in the city do not have, and which is the strongest fact the public record offers about it.

sections.heading: Two Spreckels houses, one city
sections.body: The same SF Planning dataset that names this the Floyd Spreckels Mansion names 2080 Washington Street the Spreckels Residence. They are different buildings in different neighbourhoods with different protections: 2080 Washington is an Article 10 individual landmark, while this parcel carries Category A status from a survey result alone and no local landmark protection. What links the two names has not been established here.

sections.heading: An empty permit record
sections.body: The Department of Building Inspection dataset reaches back to the mid-1970s and returns nothing at all for this address — no roofs, no alterations, no street-space filings. Of the addresses documented on this site, only one other has a permit record this empty. That is an absence of records, not evidence that nothing was done.

sections.heading: A roll that stops in 2018
sections.body: The most recent secured roll carrying this parcel is 2018, seven years behind every other address documented here, and the dataset gives no reason. The 2018 figures below follow a sale recorded in October 2014 and should not be read as current value.

sections.heading: Reported residents
sections.body: Both come from one published guide to notable residences, which names them as living here at different times and gives no dates or underlying source for either.
